order: 2 campaignIdentity key present -> identity mode; Cache-Control: private, no-store on every identity outcome
3 identity mode with a mode other than the exact string '1', or any token query key; or missing roomCode -> 400 (no downgrade to the anonymous summary)
5 identity mode without Authorization 'Bearer <non-space>' -> 401 before any store lookup or crypto
7 identity mode: authenticateRequest(req, undefined, {kind:'campaign-session', id: meta.matchId}) fails -> 401 (scope derived server-side, never read from the request)
8 identity mode: meta.coopCampaign.campaignId not a non-empty string -> 404 (same class as unknown)
9 identity mode -> 200 {matchId, status, layout, campaignId}, built field by field (meta never spread)
10 anonymous -> 200 {matchId, status, layout} exactly as before; no auth call, no cache header
contract.noWrite: HTTP claims no seat, membership, receipt or grant; WS membership/revocation/seat checks remain the authority (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:1162-1354)

privacy.productionLive: #2239 review N1: the identity mode is live and callable by any HTTP client from the moment G2A merges; reduced P2CG1G2 is only its first in-repo consumer. 'Dormant' in the behavior text means 'no in-repo caller', not inert. The mainProof must not be read as inert
privacy.whoLearnsCampaignId: Anyone presenting a live lobby code with any well-formed self-signed Ed25519 bearer: unscoped tokens, or tokens scoped to this match's campaign-session. verifyPlayerToken derives playerId from the embedded key and consults no registry, so a throwaway key suffices
privacy.PRIV1: The design-doc premise that the room code is the actual secret (2026-10-18-g2-preadmission-design.md:23) is false for co-op campaign lobbies. The entry panel creates the session as layout '1v1' with hostSeatKind 'spectator' (CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx:221-238), leaving two unoccupied human seats (Lobby.ts:285); the campaign WS path never writes meta.seats, so isJoinable (joinableLobbies.ts:126-131) holds while the match is in lobby status and GET /api/multiplayer/lobbies returns {matchId, roomCode, ...} to any verified bearer, which may be self-signed (lobbies.ts:65). A pre-gate scratch probe (deleted) confirmed a co-op campaign session meta is listed with its roomCode
privacy.incremental: Pre-existing: campaign ids and names are anonymously enumerable (GET /api/campaigns) and /api/campaigns/[id] is unauthenticated (B15); a listed code already admits a newcomer WS guest join (handleRoomCodeGuestJoin.ts header) whose snapshot includes the campaignId. G2A adds the matchId->campaignId link without taking a seat, without appearing to the host, and independent of seat-full refusal or membership revocation. It adds no seat, membership, receipt, stream or grant capability
privacy.topology: v2.2.0 enforces same-host/loopback (server.js:72; Electron pins loopback) and same-host play has no inter-participant isolation (B15 design :13, :17). Under that topology PRIV-1 is not a release blocker
privacy.ruling: Parent ruling R-PRIV-1: accept G2A as registered; Root records PRIV-1 as a B15 remote-support obligation (fix in joinableLobbies.ts / session creation before any remote/tunnel hosting claim) in a separate docs ledger amendment. G2A changes no non-G2A leaf
privacy.whyNotNarrowedHere: Requiring membership refuses the fresh guest who needs the identity before the socket exists; requiring a scoped token changes nothing (any key can sign the scope) and would break reduced G2, whose entry panel mints unscoped tokens via /api/multiplayer/auth/token (token.ts:157), not a G2/G2A leaf
otherNotes: Cache: private, no-store on every identity outcome

Oracles: missing header -> 401 before lookup; invalid bearer on a live code -> 401 whether or not co-op (row A9); unknown and non-co-op share the 404 body. Code liveness is already disclosed by the anonymous summary
Cost: Ed25519 verification only after a live-code hit; the anonymous route already has no rate limit (pre-existing); no limiter added
Bearers live up to 6h (token.ts:55); a revoked member can still read the correlation (accepted residual in the design doc)
